build_minimal_config_llm: build a minimal YAML config string for a given LLM provider, model, and API key field
build_minimal_config_sandbox: build a minimal config with a custom sandbox provider and bash tool enabled
write_config_yaml: write a config.yaml file from an example template with a specified LLM provider and model
write_env_file: write or update a .env file with API key environment variables
read_env_file: read key-value pairs from a .env file while ignoring comments
test_providers_required_fields: test that LLM, search, and web fetch providers have all required fields populated
test_search_step_reuses_key: test the search step reuses a single API key when both search and fetch use the same provider
